//: Declaration emit for the package build (scripts/build.mjs). Unlike ./tsconfig.json this does NOT alias `@cloudbitmaps/core` to core's SOURCE: that alias pulls core's files into the program and tsc would then emit THEIR declarations next to core's sources. Here `@cloudbitmaps/core` resolves through the workspace symlink to core's BUILT `dist/*.d.ts` — which is why `pnpm -r run build` builds core first.
